text: The subject is Nimra Qadir, who holds account PK**MEZN****9210, opened on 9 January 2021. The subject is declared to be a Medical sales officer (salaried) with a declared monthly income of PKR 150,000 per month. Between 2 May 2026 and 30 May 2026, the account recorded 16 credits totalling PKR 24,648,000 and 6 debits totalling PKR 22,647,000. The account received 15 cash deposits totalling PKR 24,498,000 across 4 branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch). An alert was raised by Tazama on 30 May 2026, where the Tazama typology STR-PK-01 scored 320 against an alert threshold of 300. 13 of 15 cash deposits (87%) were between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999, totalling PKR 22,952,000, which is indicative of repeated deposits just below the cash transaction reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000. The cash deposits were spread across 4 branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch), a pattern consistent with suspected structuring. There was more than one cash deposit on 1 day (22 May 2026), which is consistent with suspected structuring. Credits in the activity window were 164.3 times the declared monthly income of PKR 150,000 per month, indicative of cash volume inconsistent with the declared income. The pattern of 13 of 15 cash deposits (87%) between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999 across 4 branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch) is consistent with suspected structuring to avoid the cash transaction reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000. PKR 11,807,000 was sent to Sheraz Traders (PK**SHER****1518, Synthetic Bank A) in 3 transactions. PKR 10,840,000 was sent to Crescent Imports (PK**CRES****1592, Synthetic Bank C) in 3 transactions. Debits equal to 92% of credits were made with a median of 28.1 hours between the latest credit and each debit. There was no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media screening on 28 May 2026. L2 analyst noted on 28 May 2026 that the account was placed under enhanced monitoring pending the reporting decision.
